newsitem.title: USA: Viasoft files for 1.3 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Viasoft files for 1.3 mln common shares.

text.p: Viasoft Inc said Monday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to 1.3 million common shares.
Of the total amount, 1,040,000 common will be sold in the United States and 260,000 common will be offered on the international market.
Of the 1.3 million, 1,170,000 will be offered by Viasoft and 130,000 will be sold by selling shareholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 18,892,772 common.
The company granted U.S. underwriters a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to 156,000 additional common shares and international underwriters an additional 39,000 common shares.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Wessels, Arnold & Henderson, Soundview Financial Group Inc and Volpe Brown Whelan & Co.

Net proceeds will be used for the addition of direct sales and research and development personnel, marketing initiatives, potential acquisitions of businesses, products and technologies, the company said.
Proceeds will also be used for enhancement and integration of the Rochade product line, working capital and other general corporate purposes, Viasoft said.

Viasoft, based in Phoenix, Arizona, provides enterprise manaagement solutions that help large organizations worldwide understand, manage and evolve the larger-scale software applications that support their fundamental business processes.
